item.title: Overworld 0.5.0
item.description:
• Hover a house and a small toolbar rises above its roof. One button brings that house's manager session forward in its terminal, another opens the house card. A third, the microphone, is there but switched off until a later release. The toolbar works from the keyboard too: Tab walks the houses, Return opens the bar, Esc steps back.
  • The manager of a house now stands at its door, in the house's own colour, while its session is live.
  • On a MacBook with a notch, Overworld lives in the notch. At rest it is just the notch. When agents are waiting for you, a small count appears beside it. Click the menu bar icon, the notch or the count and a list springs open: who is waiting, then what is running; click a row to jump to it. The usual menu is now on right-click, Control-click or Option-click.
  • The menu bar menu is redrawn: a version line and a state line at the top, one column of icons, and up to nine waiting agents listed.
